50 | Gate Cleaver | varies | 1 rnd/lvl | varies | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster can cause any lock he can see within 100' to be locked (the lock is
just normally locked and can be opened normally).
@@ 2
A door (or container) can be magically “locked.” The door can be broken down
normally or the spell can be dispelled. Otherwise, the door cannot be opened
for the duration of the spell.
@@ 3
Gives the caster a special bonus of +20 for picking the lock analyzed. If the
caster describes the information gained from this spell, the listener will get
a special bonus of +10 to picking the lock analyzed.
@@ 4
When cast upon a lock, there is a 20% chance a normal lock will open, and a
45% chance that a Magic Lock will open. There is a 10% chance that any
associated traps are set off. Rolls are open-ended, and the sophistication of
the lock may modify the roll.
@@ 5
As Locklore, except applies to disarming traps.
@@ 6
As Opening I, except its chances concern disarming traps. There is a 10%
chance that the trap being disarmed is set off.
@@ 7
Causes a door to expand and jam into its frame. Roll d100 to determine the
severity of the jam (a 01 means the door is only slightly stuck; a 100 means
that the door is unopenable).
@@ 8
Reduces the inherent strength of a door by 50%. All maneuvers to break down
the door get a special bonus of +50.
@@ 9
When cast, there is a 20% chance that all locks within the area of effect are
unlocked (45% chance for Magic Locks). Roll separately for each lock in the
area of effect. Rolls are open-ended, and the sophistication of the lock may
modify the roll.
@@ 10
As Opening I, except chance is 40% (90% for Magic Locks).
@@ 11
Will vaporize a nonmagic door up to 6'' thick, 10' high and 10' wide (if the
door is thicker than 6'' it will vaporize the closest 6 inches). This will
only work on an object that is used as a door (i.e., a caster cannot Undoor a
section of wall).
@@ 12
As Disarm I, except chance is 40% (90% for magical traps).
@@ 13
As Magic Lock, except duration is 1 hour per level and the chance that an
Opening spell (or Open Prison) will work is reduced by 20%.
@@ 14
As Magic Lock, except door is unbreakable by normal means.
@@ 15
As Undoor I, except door can be up to 2'x20'x20'.
@@ 16
As Open Prison I, except chance is 40% (90% for Magic Locks).
@@ 17
As Undoor I, except door can be up to 3'x50'x50'.
@@ 18
As Magic Lock, except duration is 1 day per level and the chance that an
Opening spell (or Open Prison) will work is reduced by 40%.
@@ 19
As Undoor I, except any single door is vaporized.
@@ 20
A doorway (8'x5') is created in any wall up to 6'' deep per level of the
caster.
@@ 25
Gives the caster a 90% chance of opening a lock. The roll is openended and the
sophistication of the lock may modify the roll.
@@ 30
As Lock Mastery, except its chances concern disarming traps.
@@ 50
Caster can utilize any one of the lower level spells on this list each round.
